faces.name: Descent of the King of Knights
faces.text: At the start of the game, the player going second gets 3 Evolution Points. When paying an {icon_evolve|[evolve]} or {icon_ride|[ride]} cost, you may use an Evolution Point in lieu of 1 play point by turning it facedown. (Only one can be used per evolution or ride, and you can only activate {icon_evolve|[evolve]} or {icon_ride|[ride]} abilities once per turn.)
